prior_definitions: broad: uniform over FOV cell-center quadrature; regions: Gaussian density truncated only at FOV boundary, not hard-box support; points: delta at respective center
accurate_prior_provenance: Oracle-informed experimental condition; not a source detector output
source_input_convention: Truth-only normalization of actual discrete spatial source-input mean on 12x16 grid. All inference source hypotheses preserve original peak convention.
generator: MatchedFieldGenerator: original discrete F, source injection, P0, Q, H, R; no positivity clipping
hold_fixed: decay, diffusion and all parameters except truth source_sigma/source_rate
inference_noise: Unchanged in both controls. Mean control has zero realized initial/process/measurement perturbations; stochastic controls sample full P0,Q,R.
metrics: Same source and final field diagnostics. Per-width paired 2x2 contrasts: shape-only, amount-only and joint vs matched; interaction = joint - shape - amount + baseline. Both distance and squared distance; no percentage causal attribution.
scope: Fixed discrete grid and one source/path; matched plus three arms at four widths, each mean/noise control. Conserves injected source term, not evolving plume mass or physical methane emission.

factor_meaning.fixed_peak: Width changes at original peak rate: joint shape and integrated-amount change (old experiment).
factor_meaning.fixed_total: Width changes; peak rate divided by fixed-peak discrete input ratio, retaining baseline integrated input.
factor_meaning.amount_only: Baseline width; peak rate multiplied by fixed-peak discrete input ratio, matching old changed input.
